items.title: Harry Fairconnetue Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Man, it must have been something being on that road. Do you know what Alvin Alcorn told me once? He told me that he worked during the days when he was with Don Alcorn. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, well, I worked at, uh, Jitney Jungle, that's the store, or Leading Store here. Uh, no, we got a Winn-Dixie now. Yeah, but at that time. But at that time, I was Leading Store, I worked there for a while, during the day, and, uh, played at night. What about when you were on the road with Clarence Desdames, you couldn't work on the bus? Oh, no, we didn't, we, nobody could work on the bus. Sometime we wouldn't see a white sheet for a week. Oh, seven, eight days. Sleep on the bus? That's right. We, we have, we got…
Man, it must have been something being on that road. Do you know what Alvin Alcorn told me once? He told me that he worked during the days when he was with Don Alcorn.
